create_mlcd_vision_model: create an MLCDVisionModel from MLCDVisionConfig for vision feature extraction
build_mlcd_vision_config: build an MLCDVisionConfig with custom hidden size, layers, and attention heads for MLCD vision model
run_mlcd_vision_forward: run MLCDVisionModel forward pass on pixel values to extract image embeddings with RoPE
initialize_mlcd_weights: initialize MLCDPreTrainedModel weights for embeddings, attention, MLP, and rotary embedding layers
test_mlcd_encoder_forward: test MLCDEncoder forward pass with hidden states and rotary position embeddings
